basis: Each recipe profile specifies grams of each ingredient in 100 g of finished dish. Nutrients are calculated from the ingredient rows named by stable food_id in data/foods.json; added salt contributes 393.4 mg sodium per gram; the remaining mass is water.
limitations: Representative home-style recipes, not laboratory analyses or official IFCT prepared-dish entries. Cooking yield, oil absorption, recipe region and brand cause substantial variation. All generated dish rows are quality=approximate and must be shown as estimates.
ingredient_sources: Existing ingredient nutrient values retain their USDA FoodData Central or IFCT 2017 provenance. The added dry-roasted peanut ingredient is USDA FDC 173806 (NDB 16390).
